validation_policy.comparison: Preserve coarse and failed cases. Refine the mesh or solver; do not change these targets. A failed physical pilot remains FAIL independently of analytic component checks.
validation_policy.scope: Strict pinned Q0 inputs and the rounded historical parameter family; no data likelihood, fit, full tensor charge or production admission.

resource_pilot.qualification: Informational preparation and warm batched application only; coefficient payload is not peak RSS. No G2PERF or physical fitting-throughput claim.

limitations: Original author code and historical settings remain unavailable
Low/high CSS scale prescriptions, observable adapters, data overlap/covariance and production coverage remain unresolved
Backward evolution of the published slow endpoint requires its own mesh checks; polynomial success cannot certify it
